name: JM Forward Descendant Router v0.1 — Immutable Parent / Governed Re-entry Proof Receipt
purpose: Prove that a truthfully closed FORWARD_READY keeper can be routed into a separately identified descendant without mutating the parent, bypassing Estate intake, silently authorizing new capability, or manufacturing the descendant executable body.

implementation.reentry: JM Build Intake v0.1.1 -> JM Default Execution Body v0.1
implementation.claim_boundary: The router proves lineage eligibility and governed re-entry only. It does not create a descendant executable, authorize new capability by itself, or manufacture runtime/contact/crown proof.

directly_recovered_laws: No restart: recover the strongest existing body and correct forward.
Mesh does not mean merge; preserve distinct identities.
A handoff is the route through which difference gains legitimate control of continuity.
Frozen ancestors remain immutable; correct forward.
authority_and_recovery.donor_forge_boundary: The exact Donor Forge / Build DNA document was not independently recovered during this implementation pass. It is therefore not cited here as direct authority; no unsupported provenance claim is made.

first_ding.scope: router self-test only; live end-to-end descendant proof did not run
first_ding.cause: The synthetic keeper fixture was created outside repository ROOT while production keeper verification intentionally treats only repo-contained files as locally hash-verifiable. The self-test therefore correctly classified the fixture as non-local and required external evidence.
first_ding.correct_forward_repair: Move only the synthetic self-test TemporaryDirectory under ROOT. Production keeper verification rules remain unchanged.

live_proof.job_name: Prove immutable parent to governed descendant re-entry

parent_route.execution: AUTHORIZED -> COMPOSING -> CONTACTABLE -> PROVING -> PASS -> CLOSING -> CLOSED
parent_route.closure: PACKAGE N/A -> FREEZE PASS -> LOCK PASS -> ANCHOR PASS -> MOUNT PASS -> RECOVERY_POINTER PASS -> HANDOFF PASS

expected_red_cases.case: same frozen parent identity reused as descendant
expected_red_cases.observed: descendant name must differ from the closed parent body name
expected_red_cases.meaning: A version/change route cannot hide parent mutation behind lineage paperwork.

expected_red_cases.case: lineage-routed descendant attempts execution before Build Intake authorization
expected_red_cases.meaning: FORWARD_READY and valid lineage do not bypass the existing build front door.

live_proof.final_observed: JM Forward Descendant live proof PASS: FORWARD_READY -> immutable parent lineage -> unresolved descendant RED -> normal intake authorization -> existing execution AUTHORIZED; parent untouched and no product created.

non_claims: Synthetic parent FREEZE/LOCK/ANCHOR/MOUNT values prove routing behavior only; they do not close or freeze a real product.
The router did not create apps/jm-forward-descendant-probe-v1.1 or any descendant executable body.
Build authorization did not authorize new capability creation.
Forward lineage is not runtime/contact/crown proof.
FORWARD_READY is permission to route legitimate forward work, not permission to mutate a keeper or skip Build Intake.
proof_result: PASS — HANDOFF_COMPLETE/FORWARD_READY -> HASH-BOUND IMMUTABLE PARENT -> DISTINCT DESCENDANT LINEAGE -> UNAUTHORIZED RED -> NORMAL INTAKE AUTHORIZATION -> EXISTING EXECUTION AUTHORIZED
governing_result: The JM default build lifecycle now loops forward through the same Estate front door: closed frozen keepers are preserved as ancestors, descendant identity/intent is explicit, and forward work must recover/reroute/re-authorize before implementation.
